orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: What is debugging in computer science and programming?
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• Debugging is the process of finding and removing errors or mistakes—called bugs—in a computer program.

• When a computer program gives the wrong answer or stops working, a programmer checks the code line by line to see where the mistake is.

• After finding the exact error, the programmer fixes it so that the program works smoothly.

• Learning how to debug helps students build strong problem-solving and logical thinking skills in computer studies.
